title: Acute Gastroenteritis / Diarrhea with Dehydration
audio_transcript_raw: Vikram Singh, 29 year male. Dast aur ulti ho rahi hai subah se, 5 episodes of loose motions with mild abdominal cramps. Acute Gastroenteritis. Start Cifran 500 morning and night for 5 days after food. Sporlac tablet subah shaam for 5 days. ORS 1 packet in 1 liter water sip by sip. Pan D one capsule before food for 5 days. Return if vomiting does not stop.
